fusions.name: Straggler Nip
fusions.desc: A darting nip at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Circling the Herd
fusions.desc: A full circuit that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for each ally near you (max 24%).

fusions.name: Warm Flank
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and your allies for 8 seconds. A circling escort fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Well-Fed Calm
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
